product.available: China: on sale now (¥319). US: shipping on Amazon now

strengths: Verified Amazon buyers rate it well: M850L 4.3★ (17 ratings), M840L 4.5★ (15 ratings)
Ergonomic comfort for all-day use — repeatedly the #1 praised attribute across buyers
Silent operation — buyers say the quiet clicks are 'blissful' once adjusted
SmartWheel adaptive scroll — one buyer calls it 'the best mouse wheel I've used' (precise slow, fast auto-far)
3-device Easy-Switch — buyers call the numbered Bluetooth switching seamless and instant, 'one of the better implementations'
~2-year battery life on 1× AA (class-leading); starter battery included
Action Ring AI shortcuts (Copilot, ChatGPT, screen lock)
Media echo: Tom's Guide calls it 'unparalleled comfort for just $49'
weaknesses: No USB receiver in the box — Bluetooth-only causes occasional connectivity blips; Logi Bolt sold separately (~$14). Echoed by Amazon buyers AND Tom's Guide
Silent-click regression: a 1★ buyer says the M850L (and MX Master 4) clicks are 'significantly louder' than the older M650 — 'when I'm shopping for silent click, I expect silent click'
At ~$50/$40 some buyers expect a rechargeable mouse, not a AA cell (Amazon 3★/1★)
M840L build feels cheap/too lightweight for some — 'feels like totally cheap plastic' (Amazon 3★ & 2★)
Sleep/wake lag — cursor jumps for a split second after ~10s idle while the mouse wakes (Amazon 2★)
Basic functions (side-button page fwd/back) not preset out of box — requires Logi Options+ install (Amazon 4★)
Cushion doesn't reach palm for larger-handed users — Senses.se AND a 4★ buyer confirm the palm rests above the cushion; one calls it 'kinda pointless'
